hunks.description: Use Treeview (the ttk widget style name), rather than TTreeview, so room/area rows inherit the dark background and readable foreground.
hunks.search_block:
style.configure("TTreeview", background=INSET, fieldbackground=INSET,
                    foreground=TEXT, rowheight=25, bordercolor=BORDER,
                    borderwidth=0, font=FONT_UI)
    style.map("TTreeview", background=[("selected", ACCENT)],
              foreground=[("selected", "#FFFFFF")])
hunks.replace_block:
style.configure("Treeview", background=INSET, fieldbackground=INSET,
                    foreground=TEXT, rowheight=25, bordercolor=BORDER,
                    borderwidth=0, font=FONT_UI)
    style.map("Treeview", background=[("selected", ACCENT)],
              foreground=[("selected", "#FFFFFF")])

forward.description: Fix the Areas / Rooms list background and selection colors using the actual ttk.Treeview style name.
